input.title: The Frozen Ascent
input.scene_heading: Scene 1: Ext. The Frozen Ascent - Day
input.scene_intent_text:
Emotional Target: Relentless ascetic endurance confronting feral demonic agitation, transitioning into overwhelming cosmic shock.
Atmospheric Direction: Oppressive, desolate, violent, transcendent.
Camera Intent:
Establish spatial hierarchy through high-angle wide shots of Krodha looking down at Durvasa to convey predator vs. prey tension.
Utilize extreme macro inserts on Durvasa's frost-sealed lips and unblinking eyelids to prove unbreakable resolve without words.
Employ sudden wide pull-backs during the avalanche strike to dramatize physical annihilation.
Return to centered medium close-ups on the seated ascetic to demonstrate moral and spiritual triumph.
Spatial Staging & Distance Progression:
Phase 1 (Distant / Oppressive): Wide vista; extreme long shot of Durvasa trudging, framed under Krodha's massive outspread wings.
Phase 2 (Converging / Kinetic): Mid-scale tracking of Durvasa's steps intercut with dynamic low-angle shots of Krodha crushing peak spires.
Phase 3 (Immediate / Confrontational): Medium shot of Durvasa seated cross-legged on the snow; eye-level alignment with Krodha's twin heads recoiling in shock; cutting to a tight macro of Rudra's forehead.

shots.camera_movement: Steep vertical tilt-up tracking staff extraction
shots.frame_description: Foreground snow-packed mountain path leading vertically upward, midground Durvasa pulling his wooden staff from deep permafrost, towering Himalayan couloir stretching into the upper frame
shots.character_action: (Opening) Durvasa firmly yanks wooden staff from frozen permafrost -> plants leading foot uphill -> strides deliberately forward through deep snow crust
shots.sound_effects: Staff crunching into frozen crust + whistling mountain wind

shots.frame_description: Extreme vertical macro framing on Durvasa's lower face and jawline, showing crystalline frost sealing his tightly closed lips under ascetic silence
shots.character_action: (Continuation from previous shot: continuing uphill stride) Frost-crusted lips remain clamped shut -> chest expands in measured nasal breath -> chin tilts slightly upward
shots.sound_effects: Controlled nasal breath + ice crystal friction

shots.camera_movement: Top-down plunge tilt sweeping from high cliff peak down sheer couloir
shots.frame_description: Top-down vertical plunge from towering cliff spires looking down at the narrow ascending path below, revealing colossal two-headed Gandaberunda-Krodha perched in upper frame glaring downward
shots.character_action: (Continuation from previous shot: establishing predator perch) Gandaberunda perches upon sharp vertical spire -> unfurls massive crimson-black wings across upper frame -> tilts twin raptor heads straight downward
shots.sound_effects: Heavy quill rustle + howling canyon wind

shots.camera_movement: Dynamic low-angle crash push-in tilting upward toward dual heads
shots.frame_description: Towering low-angle close-up framing Krodha's dual raptor heads stacked vertically in frame, four burning eyes glaring down as both beaks snap open to mock the ascetic
shots.character_action: (Continuation from previous shot: locking gaze downward) Twin raptor beaks snap open together -> venomous hissing laughter rumbles in throat -> dual heads crane forward
shots.dialogue: Krodha: Yeh adiyal aise nahi maanega.
shots.sound_effects: Harsh dual-tone avian screech + iron talons scraping stone

shots.camera_movement: Rapid vertical tilt-down tracking downward leap from peak to lower crag
shots.frame_description: High-angle vertical cascade tracking Gandaberunda-Krodha leaping downwards across towering frozen spires, heavy iron talons crushing peaks into falling rock avalanches
shots.character_action: (Continuation from previous shot: leaping down spires) Gandaberunda pushes off summit spire -> drops talons onto second peak -> leaps to third and fourth crags -> permafrost shatters underfoot
shots.sound_effects: Glacial bedrock shattering crack + rockfall cascade thuds

shots.camera_movement: Low-angle tracking upward tilt moving with advancing footsteps
shots.frame_description: Ground-level towering low-angle vertical tracking shot behind Durvasa, framing his staff striking snow in foreground while shattered spires collapse in upper background
shots.character_action: (Continuation from previous shot: maintaining uphill ascent) Durvasa turns chin slightly toward falling debris -> refocuses gaze straight ahead -> drives wooden staff firmly into snow crust
shots.sound_effects: Rhythmic staff strikes into hard snow + distant rockfall rumble

shots.camera_movement: Extreme low-angle vertical tilt-up from Durvasa to towering avalanche wall
shots.frame_description: Deep vertical composition framing a towering hundred-foot wall of cascading powder snow surging down the vertical mountain chute toward the lone small figure of Durvasa in the lower third
shots.character_action: (Continuation from previous shot: avalanche descending chute) Massive hundred-foot snow wall surges down vertical ravine -> engulfs upper rock faces -> cascades toward standing ascetic below
shots.sound_effects: Deafening low-frequency avalanche roar + rushing air blast

shots.camera_movement: Steep upward tilt with rapid push-in to gaping dual beaks
shots.frame_description: Towering low-angle vertical frame of Gandaberunda-Krodha hovering at the top of the 9:16 frame with outspread wings, twin beaks roaring down into the storm
shots.character_action: (Continuation from previous shot: hovering above avalanche crest) Gandaberunda flares broad wings outward -> arches twin necks forward -> roars thunderously into descending storm
shots.dialogue: Krodha: Krodh kar, Durvasa! Apni Shakti jaga!
shots.sound_effects: Piercing dual screech + howling whirlwind roar

shots.camera_movement: Dynamic vertical arc tilt sweeping around the laughing beast
shots.frame_description: High-angle vertical view of Gandaberunda-Krodha perched atop the snowy crag, throwing both heads upward in wild mocking laughter before turning its massive winged body away

shots.camera_movement: Fast vertical tilt-up ascending from snow-embedded tip to fluttering flag
shots.frame_description: Tight vertical insert rising from the snow base up the dark rosewood staff, where the triangular saffron flag flutters resiliently against settling snow clouds
shots.character_action: (Continuation from previous shot: mist clearing around staff) Snowdust settles around upright staff -> triangular saffron flag unfurls -> fabric snaps crisply in rising alpine breeze
shots.sound_effects: Sharp fabric snap in wind + gentle snow settling hiss

shots.camera_movement: Slow vertical push-in tilting slightly upward toward the seated ascetic
shots.frame_description: Perfectly centered vertical full shot revealing Durvasa seated in immovable Padmasana behind his planted staff, his snow-covered body and matted jata unyielding in the center frame
shots.character_action: (Continuation from previous shot: unveiling seated posture) Avalanched snow slides off shoulders -> matted jata dreadlocks hold rigid -> cross-legged Padmasana posture remains completely motionless
shots.sound_effects: Snow slumping off shoulders + complete drop to dead wind silence

shots.camera_movement: Majestic vertical crane-tilt ascending from mountain ridge toward the high pinnacle
shots.frame_description: Extreme vertical composition of Mount Kailash summit needle piercing the upper sky, where colossal Rudra sits in deep Dhyan Mudra, a subtle serene smile forming on his lips
shots.character_action: (Continuation from previous shot: cutaway to highest summit) Colossal seated deity rests in serene Dhyan Mudra -> lip corners curve slightly into a subtle faint smile

shots.camera_movement: Vertical whip-pan crash push-in plunging toward wide-eyed twin heads
shots.frame_description: Tight vertical close-up of Krodha's twin raptor heads snapping violently downward toward the slope, four burning eyes bulging in shocked disbelief as laughter freezes
shots.character_action: (Continuation from previous shot: freezing mid-turn) Krodha's turning motion locks dead -> twin heads snap downward -> four burning eyes widen in sudden horror
shots.sound_effects: Sudden choked throat gasp + dead ambient silence

input.scene_heading: Scene 1: EXT. — THE FINAL MOUNTAIN PATH — DAY
input.scene_intent_text:
Emotion: Fierce inner torment resolving into transcendent divine stillness.
Atmosphere: Mythic Himalayan grandeur, high-altitude tension, kinetic siege, cosmic stillness.
Camera Intention: Capture the overwhelming spatial scale and immediate lethal jeopardy, contrasting the massive physical momentum of the guardians against the absolute spiritual centeredness of the sage.
Spatial Staging: Durvasa stands centered on the narrow snow ledge; the breached ice wall and charging Rakshak vanguard flank camera-left/rear; Rudra, Nandi, and Vasuki loom stationary across camera-right against the cloud precipice.
Distance Design: Wide scale establishing colossal environment → medium two-shots capturing Gandaberunda hovering overhead → macro close-ups on the suspended blade at the throat → low-angle full shot of the Natraj shadow alignment.

shots.frame_description: Peter Jackson three-layer deep composition: foreground jagged frost-encrusted rock rifts partially occlude the frame; in the midground, Durvasa stands barefoot on the narrow snowpack ledge; in the deep background, the colossal 300-foot Rudra looms across the abyssal gorge against towering Himalayan precipices
shots.character_action: (Opening) Durvasa stands grounded with bare feet on packed snow; the smoldering dark brand on his bare chest pulses; his nostrils flare, lips part slightly, and throat muscles tighten beneath his long grey beard; Danda held vertically against his left side
shots.sound_effects: High-altitude mountain wind shear + deep visceral heartbeat thud

shots.frame_description: Macro extreme close-up with foreground flying snow crystals: Durvasa's weathered face fills the vertical frame as his heavy ash-dusted eyelids close tightly, his right palm rising to cover the pulsing chest brand
shots.character_action: (Following previous shot: facial tension easing) Durvasa firmly shuts his eyelids; his chest expands with a deep inhalation and lowers steadily; his right hand rises and presses flat against the agni-chinh while his left hand anchors beside the Danda
shots.sound_effects: Whistling mountain gale + deep resonant chest vocal vibration

shots.frame_description: Over-the-shoulder perspective with Durvasa's ash-smeared shoulder and fluttering saffron uttariya cutting across the left foreground, framing the colossal Rudra across the swirling cloud precipice as his vertical third eye closes
shots.character_action: (Following previous shot: mantra resonating) Rudra sits in monumental cosmic composure; the vertical third eyelid on his forehead lowers smoothly into a sealed slit; Vasuki rests motionless across his collarbone; Nandi sits unmoving behind him
shots.sound_effects: Deep sub-harmonic mountain hum + wind rushing through cloud abyss

shots.frame_description: Low worm's-eye perspective looking upward from packed snowdrifts: the sheer vertical glacial ice wall shudders violently and cleaves open along a massive fault line, showering crystalline ice shards into the foreground
shots.character_action: (Following previous shot: third eye sealing) The snow crust beneath Durvasa's bare feet trembles violently; the colossal vertical ice wall fractures from its base to its upper crest, splitting into a massive gaping breach
shots.sound_effects: Tectonic sub-bass boom (DHAM!) + shattering glacial ice crack

shots.frame_description: Peter Jackson wide battle vanguard charge: jagged ice monoliths flank the foreground while the Kailash Rakshak horde pours out through the cleaved ice breach, brandished swords, tridents, and maces filling the midground
shots.character_action: (Following previous shot: ice breach cleaving) The vast host of Kailash Rakshaks, mythical beasts, and fierce ganas surges through the fractured ice portal onto the ledge, thrusting talwaars, trishuls, bhalas, and gadas toward the camera
shots.dialogue: RAKSHAKON KI SENA: Om Namah Parvati Pataye! Har Har Mahadev!
shots.sound_effects: Thunderous unified war chant + stampeding footfalls crunching ice

shots.frame_description: Dynamic low-angle tracking shot with flying snow clumps in the foreground: Yaksha charges aggressively along the icy ridge, brandishing a heavy bronze talwaar high above his ornate crown
shots.character_action: (Following previous shot: horde surging) Yaksha sprints forward across the compressed snow with heavy strides, brandishing a bronze talwaar in his right hand while thrusting his left arm forward for momentum
shots.dialogue: YAKSHA: Kailash par kadam rakhne ki himmat kaise hui teri?
shots.sound_effects: Heavy warrior foot stomps on packed snow + metallic blade swing

shots.frame_description: Dutch-angle dynamic handheld track with blurred ice shelves in the foreground: Pishachi sprints in flanking formation, raising a sharp iron trishul with both hands and thrusting its prongs forward
shots.character_action: (Following previous shot: Yaksha charging) Pishachi sprints forward across the jagged ice, raising a two-handed iron trishul and thrusting the three sharp prongs directly toward the lens
shots.dialogue: PISHACHI: Rudra ke dwar ka tu adhikari nahi!
shots.sound_effects: High-pitched battle screech + weapon shaft swoosh through air

shots.frame_description: Lateral tracking shot with razor icicles passing across the foreground: Yakshani vaults across a frozen crevasse, whirling a curved talwaar in a wide sweeping arc
shots.character_action: (Following previous shot: Pishachi thrusting) Yakshani leaps across a frozen ridge, whirling her curved steel talwaar in a rapid circular arc with her right hand while stabilizing her leap with her left arm
shots.dialogue: YAKSHANI: Apne maun ke peeche chhupne wale rishi—marne ke liye taiyaar ho ja!
shots.sound_effects: Heavy silk garment rustle + blade whistling through mountain wind

shots.frame_description: Low-angle two-shot vertically stacking Gandaberunda's snapping twin beaks at the top of the frame and Durvasa's motionless ash-covered face in the center foreground, charging guardians visible in the background
shots.character_action: (Following previous shot: wings unfurling) Gandaberunda angles both predatory beaks downward toward Durvasa's face, mocking his restraint; Durvasa maintains closed eyes and steady breath while the charging guardian army approaches in the rear

shots.sound_effects: Dual-voiced demonic hissing resonance + roaring army stampede

shots.frame_description: Semi-circular orbital crane tracking around Durvasa with Gandaberunda's beating wings framing the upper edge, as Yaksha, Pishachi, and Yakshani encircle his position with raised weapons
shots.character_action: (Following previous shot: demon taunting) Gandaberunda pulls back its twin beaks and beats its wings; Yaksha, Pishachi, and Yakshani close the final steps from the left, lunging forward in unison with raised weapons aimed at the sage
shots.dialogue: Gandaberunda: Ek vaar kar. Varna sab jaan lenge— tu rishi nahi, apne hi Gandaberunda ka dara hua daas hai.
shots.sound_effects: Wing vortex wind turbulence + synchronized weapon thrusts

shots.frame_description: Crash push-in to Durvasa's neck: a razor talwaar and sharp trishul points lunge within millimeters of his flesh, while a massive serpent binds his torso and giant celestial beasts leap overhead
shots.character_action: (Following previous shot: simultaneous lunge) A talwaar blade thrusts directly toward Durvasa's bare throat; a trishul tip points at his heart; a massive naag coils tightly around his arms, pinning them to his ribs; celestial beasts leap through the air
shots.sound_effects: Piercing demonic scream + slicing air of lunging steel blades

shots.frame_description: Peter Jackson deep-focus tableau of universal time freeze: the razor blade hangs completely motionless one finger-width from Durvasa's throat, roaring beasts frozen mid-leap in the upper frame
shots.character_action: (Following previous shot: crash push-in to blade tip) Universal time abruptly halts; the razor blade stops motionless millimeters from Durvasa's throat; leaping lions, tigers, and spirits freeze suspended in mid-air; Rudra remains completely still across the ledge
shots.sound_effects: Total acoustic dropout (dead silence + high-frequency vacuum ring)

shots.frame_description: 360-degree orbital track around Durvasa's suspended silhouette through frozen weapon tips and beast paws, as he calmly joins his bound hands and lifts one foot into the sacred Natraj stance
shots.character_action: (Following previous shot: total time freeze) Durvasa turns his face toward Rudra across the frozen guardians; his bound hands press together at his chest center; he slowly lifts his left foot from the snow into a balanced Natraj dance posture
shots.sound_effects: Faint harmonic bell vibration ringing in acoustic vacuum

shots.frame_description: Low-angle vertical crane tilt tracking from Durvasa's four-armed shadow on the snowfield up across his balanced stance to his serene face as his chest expands beneath his saffron wrap
shots.character_action: (Following previous shot: foot lifting into stance) Durvasa's shadow stretches across the snow in the Natraj silhouette; within the shadow, two additional hand silhouettes rise holding a damru and flaming agni; Durvasa's chest expands
shots.sound_effects: Deep resonant mantra vibration echoing across mountain peaks

shots.frame_description: Macro extreme close-up on Durvasa's eyes snapping open as time resumes, releasing expanding ripples of golden ether into the high-altitude air
shots.character_action: (Following previous shot: mantra completion) Time resumes; shimmering golden waves climb from his feet along his limbs to his brow; Durvasa snaps his eyelids open, releasing expanding golden ripples into the atmosphere
shots.sound_effects: Rushing energy chime + crystalline wind resonance

input.scene_heading: Scene 2: EXT. — THE OPENING ICE WALL — CONTINUOUS
input.scene_intent_text:
Emotion: Solemn determination shadowed by psychological dread.
Atmosphere: Pristine glacial cold transitioning into abyssal darkness.
Camera Intention: Frame the threshold of the unknown; emphasize the final separation between the exterior mythic world and Durvasa's internal subconscious realm.
Spatial Staging: The massive Damru-shaped glacial fracture dominates the upper midground; Durvasa advances from the bright snowfield in the foreground directly into the absolute black portal in the background.
Distance Design: Low-angle wide viewing the Damru aperture → tracking medium shot behind Durvasa crossing the threshold → tight close-up on the detached shadow remaining behind on the frozen floor.

previous_shot.frame_description: Close-up tilt-down framing Durvasa as Gandaberunda folds inward into a dark vortex and gets drawn back into the smoldering chest brand
previous_shot.character_action: (Following previous shot: Rudra smiling) Gandaberunda's two heads jerk upward as its dark body collapses inward into a swirling vortex, sinking back into the agni-chinh; Durvasa's right hand presses firmly over the mark while his left hand grips the Danda
previous_shot.orientation: 3/4 front facing right
previous_shot.sound_effects: Inward rushing vortex hiss + solid chest impact thump

shots.frame_description: Monumental establishing wide shot: the colossal Damru-shaped glacial ice section cleaves loose and crashes onto the snowbase (KRRRACK), uncovering the pitch-black cave entrance
shots.character_action: (Following previous shot: Gandaberunda sealed) A vast symmetrical crack in the shape of a colossal Damru tears through the glacier wall; the huge central ice block breaks away and crashes onto the snowbase (KRRRACK), uncovering an abyss of pure darkness within
shots.dialogue: Gandaberunda (V.O.): Bahar ke Gandaberunda ko toh sambhal liya, Durvasa…
shots.sound_effects: Deep seismic crack (KRRRACK) + heavy ice slab crash on snowpack

shots.frame_description: Low-angle medium shot pushing in on Durvasa's back as he raises the dark wooden Danda before the yawning black cavern aperture
shots.character_action: (Following previous shot: ice falling) Durvasa raises the rosewood Danda in his right hand; his left hand rests near the sealed agni-chinh; he stares intently into the black cave opening, jaw tightening as he draws a steady breath
shots.dialogue: Gandaberunda (V.O.): Jab ekaant mein khud ke andar ke paap dikhenge, tabh kaise khud ko sambhaloge.
shots.sound_effects: Subterranean cavern wind drone + deep ascetic inhale

shots.frame_description: Ground-level tracking shot following Durvasa's bare feet crossing from snow onto the frozen cave threshold as his physical shadow detaches behind him on the ice
shots.character_action: (Following previous shot: standing before cavern) Durvasa's bare feet leave the snow and step onto the frozen cave floor; as he moves inward, his dark shadow physically detaches from his left side and remains anchored on the ice floor behind him
shots.sound_effects: Bare footstep crunch on snow transitioning to solid ice tap

shots.frame_description: Subject-locked push-in behind Durvasa as he walks deeper into the pitch-black cave while his detached silhouette remains standing on the threshold
shots.character_action: (Following previous shot: shadow separation) Durvasa advances into the deep cavern darkness holding the Danda forward; the detached shadow stands completely still on the ice floor behind his left side
shots.sound_effects: Low cavernous resonant drone + distant hollow echo

input.title: The Eclipse Prince
input.scene_heading: Scene 1: Royal Tournament Pavilion — The Arrogant Parade (Shots 1–6 / 45s)
input.scene_intent_text:
Emotional Objective: Unchecked martial hubris; squared shoulders, lifted chin, smirking eye-locks.
Atmospheric Direction: Oppressive courtly pomp, intoxicating hubris, celebratory adulation.
Camera Intent: Smooth crane arm lowering from the high arena rim to an eye-level tracking dolly before the warhorse, capturing Ranvijay centered within the 9:16 safe area while the 16:9 wings capture cheering tiers.
Spatial Narrative: Ranvijay commands the central sand runway; Someshwar towers on the high northern throne dais.
Distance Design: Wide arena vista gliding smoothly into medium tracking of the stallion and close-up smirks.

shots.camera_movement: Aerial crane down into a low track alongside the horse
shots.frame_description: Grand circular sand arena seen from above, carved stone stands packed with citizens raising sun-emblem flags, descending to sand level as Ranvijay rides the jet-black stallion to mid-arena with his jeweled sword raised. Panel keyframe: end of the crane, low on the sand, Ranvijay mid-arena in the centre of frame.
shots.character_action: The royal gong crashes and the citizens raise sun-emblem flags. The camera descends to the sand as Ranvijay rides in on the black stallion, which stops mid-arena with its bells ringing, and he raises his jeweled sword. Continuity: he enters from the south gate and travels screen-right.
shots.sound_effects: Royal gong crash + hooves thudding across dry sand + brass rein bells ringing + swelling crowd roar

shots.camera_movement: Slow pan across the cheering stands
shots.frame_description: Reverse angle across the arena to tiered stands packed with cheering citizens waving sun flags, Ranvijay a small mounted silhouette in the foreground
shots.character_action: The citizens cheer and wave flags, with Ranvijay small on horseback in the foreground. Continuity: he has wheeled the horse to face the south stands, and turns back toward the courtiers' stand in shot 3.
shots.dialogue: Several Citizens: Dekho dekho kaun aaya...Suryagarh ka sher aaya...Rajkumar Ranvijay ki jay, Rajkumar Ranvijay ki jay
shots.sound_effects: Rhythmic crowd chant + clapping + cloth flags fluttering

shots.frame_description: Courtiers' gallery with carved stone platforms and scalloped silk canopies, Ranvijay reining the black stallion to a halt before it and grinning up at the stand
shots.character_action: Ranvijay walks the horse up to halt in front of the courtiers' seating canopy and looks up at the stand, grinning. Continuity: he arrives moving screen-right, as in shot 1; his jeweled sword is now sheathed at his left hip.
shots.dialogue: Prince Ranvijay: Dekha, rajguru? mere aagman bhar se hi praja mein sahas aur utsaah ki lahar daud gayi..
shots.sound_effects: Hooves slowing on sand + creak of leather reins + stallion snort + jingling brass bells

shots.frame_description: Low angle up into the courtiers' seating canopy where Badrinath in saffron robes raises both hands toward the arena among turbaned courtiers
shots.character_action: In the seating canopy among the courtiers, Badrinath raises both hands toward Ranvijay with a smooth smile. Continuity: Badrinath stands at the front rail, at the dais end of the courtiers' stand.
shots.dialogue: Rajguru Badrinath: ye toh hona hi tha rajkumar, sampoorna rajya is baat ko bhalibhati jaanta hai ki Swarnadweep ke asli rakshak aap hi hai.
shots.sound_effects: Clicking rudraksha beads + rustle of saffron robes + low crowd hum

shots.frame_description: Right-flank view of the arena, Ranvijay leaning back in his red-and-gold saddle with a smug laugh, sweeping his hand across the stands
shots.character_action: Ranvijay leans back in the saddle with a smug laugh and sweeps his hand toward the crowd. Continuity: same halt position and horse direction as shot 3.
shots.dialogue: Prince Ranvijay: rakshak nahi rajguru ..main is rajya ka hone wala samraat hun aur ye praja meri daas...
shots.sound_effects: Ranvijay's laughter + creaking saddle leather + stamping hooves + rein bells

shots.frame_description: Raised throne under the sun-carved canopy, Maharaja Someshwar in gold robes seated tall and striking the carved armrest with his ringed hand
shots.character_action: Someshwar sits beneath the sun-carved throne canopy and strikes the armrest with his ring.
shots.dialogue: Maharaja Someshwar: swagat kijiye aapke hone wale samraat ka..
shots.sound_effects: Sharp crack of ring on carved armrest + rustle of canopy silks + crowd falling quiet

input.title: The Eclipse Prince
input.scene_heading: Scene 2: Agnivesh's Reading Room — The Still Center (Shots 7–10 / 28s)
input.scene_intent_text:
Emotional Objective: Deep meditative composure; slow turning of aged parchment; eyes tranquil despite distant roars.
Atmospheric Direction: Secluded gravitas, scholastic isolation.
Camera Intent: Slow linear dolly push-in toward Agnivesh seated in the window alcove, followed by a steady lateral slider tracking his deliberate stride toward the arched door.
Spatial Narrative: Claustrophobic stone interior framed by vertical shelves, insulating Agnivesh from the martial frenzy outside.
Distance Design: Macro detail of fingers on binding → Medium waist-level glide → Smooth follow shot to the threshold.

previous_shot.spatial_relationship: Maharaja Someshwar (safe-centre, Mid, seated, middle third), with the throne back and sun canopy in the upper third; off-screen, Ranvijay is below screen-right

previous_shot.sound_effects: Sharp crack of ring on carved armrest + rustle of canopy silks + crowd falling quiet

shots.camera_movement: Over Someshwar's shoulder down to the arena, then crane up
shots.frame_description: High angle over Someshwar's shoulder down to the sand, the king pointing at Ranvijay, who raises both hands to the cheering stands
shots.character_action: Someshwar points toward Ranvijay. Their eyes meet and both smile. The citizens start cheering again, and Ranvijay raises both hands to take in the applause.
shots.dialogue: Several Citizens: Yuvraj Ranvijay ki jay!
shots.sound_effects: Crowd cheer swelling + heavy gold robes rustling + stallion snort

shots.frame_description: Throne under the sun canopy, Someshwar still seated, opening his arm wide to the whole arena in challenge
shots.character_action: Someshwar, still seated, opens his arm to the whole arena as if daring anyone. Continuity: still seated, same throne framing as shot 6.
shots.dialogue: Maharaja Someshwar: Poore rajya mein koi hai jo Yuvraj Ranvijay ko chunauti de sake?
shots.sound_effects: Crowd dropping to an expectant hush + sweep of heavy robes + wind through banners

shots.frame_description: Sprawling royal palace of endless rooms and terraces under bright daylight, the arena a distant shape beyond
shots.character_action: The sprawling palace with its endless rooms. The arena roar carries faintly across.
shots.sound_effects: Faint distant arena roar + wind across palace terraces + birdsong

shots.camera_movement: Slow dolly-in between the shelves, then a pan with him to the door
shots.frame_description: Quiet reading room lined with ancient books, Agnivesh in shadow by the narrow window turning brittle pages, then closing the book and walking to the door
shots.character_action: Agnivesh sits in shadow by the narrow window, slowly turning the pages of the ancient book. The distant roar reaches him. He closes the book, rises and walks out, book in hand. Continuity: he exits screen-left with the book in his left hand, the worn ancestral sword sheathed at his left hip.
shots.sound_effects: Brittle pages turning + muffled distant roar + book closing + soft footsteps on stone

input.scene_intent_text:

shots.character_action: Seated in their separate stand, the courtiers chant his name mockingly, while the citizens keep up their noise behind.
shots.dialogue: Several Royal Courtiers: Agnivesh! Agnivesh! Agnivesh
shots.sound_effects: Rhythmic mocking chant + slow clapping + citizen noise behind

input.title: The Eclipse Prince
input.scene_heading: Scene 4: Royal Tournament Pavilion — The Public Shaming & Blade Surrender (Shots 13–38 / 199s)
input.scene_intent_text:
Emotional Objective: Venomous filial disgust from the king; cold gloating from Ranvijay; compressed righteous fury behind Agnivesh's locked jaw.
Atmospheric Direction: Visceral court tribunal, severe humiliation, supernatural dread.
Camera Intent:
Slow crane pedestal moving vertically between Someshwar's commanding downward gaze and Agnivesh's upright posture.
Smooth lateral slider passes tracking Ranvijay circling on the sand.
Stable locked-off medium close-ups on Rajguru's calculating smirk and Devika's unsmiling eyes.
Deliberate mechanical creep-in to the horizontal blade resting on open palms.
Slow, steady macro dolly toward Agnivesh's singeing cuff as the molten-gold brand activates.
Spatial Narrative: Triangular standoff: Someshwar elevated on the dais, Ranvijay standing over the sand, Agnivesh pinned on his knees between them.
Distance Design: Medium confrontation masters tightening systematically into intimate close-ups of eyes, clenched jaws, open hands, and radiant skin.

shots.character_action: Ranvijay turns in the saddle toward the entrance. Agnivesh walks across the sand toward him, reading as he goes. Continuity: Ranvijay stays where he halted in front of the courtiers' stand; Agnivesh travels screen-left toward him, the open book in his left hand.
shots.sound_effects: Hooves shifting on sand + crowd murmur rising + footsteps on sand + page turning

shots.camera_movement: Slow push-in, low angle on the rider
shots.frame_description: Left-flank low angle on Ranvijay high in the saddle, laughing and pointing down at Agnivesh standing small on the sand
shots.character_action: Ranvijay calls down from horseback, laughing and pointing at him. Continuity: Agnivesh still holds the book in his left hand.
shots.dialogue: Prince Ranvijay: jise tum sab yuddh ke liye bula rahe ho vo koi yoddha nahi balki ek durbal aur kaayar naari ke samaan hai....
shots.sound_effects: Ranvijay's laughter + jingling rein bells + ripple of crowd chuckles

shots.camera_movement: Slow arc on Badrinath, then a pan down to the laughing stands
shots.frame_description: Courtiers' canopy as Badrinath turns toward the throne, panning down to the stands where citizens laugh and whisper and one leans out to jeer. Panel keyframe: Badrinath at the front rail turning toward the throne at screen-right.
shots.character_action: Badrinath turns from the courtiers' canopy toward the throne with his soft, poisonous request. The camera pans to the citizens, who laugh and whisper, and one leans out to jeer. Continuity: the jeering citizen leans toward Agnivesh below.
shots.dialogue: Rajguru Badrinath: kaayaron ko yuddh se door hi rakhna chahiye maharaj. Main aapse anurodh karta hun Yuvraj Ranvijay ko is rajya ka hone wala samraat ghoshit kiya jaaye. / Citizen: haar ke dar se.. haath mein kitaab leke aaya hai...
shots.sound_effects: Clicking rudraksha beads + hushed whispers + spreading laughter + single jeering voice

shots.camera_movement: Crane down with him and back up, then a slow push-in toward his joined hands
shots.frame_description: Arena sand at ground level, Agnivesh before the mounted Ranvijay closing his book, laying it on the sand, then rising to greet the dais with joined hands as his right sleeve shifts up
shots.character_action: Agnivesh stops in front of Ranvijay, closes his book and places it on the sand. He rises, turns to the dais and greets his father with joined hands, and his right sleeve shifts up. Continuity: the book goes down from his left hand; his right sleeve slides up as his palms join, setting up the insert.
shots.sound_effects: Book closing + soft thud on sand + silk sleeve rustle + crowd quieting

shots.frame_description: Insert on Agnivesh's inner right wrist under the clean royal-blue cuff, the faint pale-gold hilt-shaped mark visible for a split second before he tugs the sleeve down
shots.character_action: Insert: for a split second the faint hilt-shaped mark shows on his inner right wrist. He tugs the sleeve back down. Continuity: same pranaam hand pose and sleeve as the end of shot 16.
shots.sound_effects: Soft rustle of silk + faint low hum

shots.frame_description: Low angle on the throne, Someshwar scoffing then turning his face away in agony and disgust beneath the sun canopy
shots.character_action: Someshwar scoffs, then speaks with real agony and disgust, turning his face away. Continuity: still seated.
shots.dialogue: Maharaja Someshwar: HUH... / Maharaja Someshwar: Tujh jaise kaayar aur darpook insaan ko apna putra kahna .. aa thuuu.. ye mera aur poori praja ka apmaan hai..
shots.sound_effects: Sharp scoff + rustle of gold robes + collective crowd gasp

shots.camera_movement: Static from behind him, then a slow arc around to his front
shots.frame_description: From behind Agnivesh toward the raised dais, arcing around to his front as he speaks up to the throne with the silent stands behind. Panel keyframe: start of the move, from behind Agnivesh up to the dais, the King seated on the throne above him.
shots.character_action: Agnivesh straightens and the whole arena goes quiet. He speaks up to the dais, low and controlled, holding his ground. Continuity: hands back at his sides after the pranaam. The book he set down in shot 16 stays where it lies.
shots.dialogue: Agnivesh: Pitashri..Yeh mera bhi rajya hai aur main is rajya ka vaasi hu..mujhe bhi apna samarthya dikhaane ka mauka milna chahiye
shots.sound_effects: Arena falling silent + wind snapping the banners

shots.camera_movement: Push-in, tilt down after the falling sword, then crane up to the stands
shots.frame_description: Ground-level on Agnivesh facing the still-mounted Ranvijay as he draws the ancestral sword, gold flaring through his sleeve and the blade dropping to the sand, then rising high over the laughing stands and the dais. Panel keyframe: the draw, with Agnivesh facing Ranvijay, the sword leaving the scabbard and gold flaring at his right wrist.
shots.character_action: He turns to Ranvijay, sets his right fist on the hilt and draws the sword. The mark flares gold through his sleeve, a jolt runs up his arm, and the sword slips onto the sand. The camera rises to the stands, where everyone bursts out laughing, Someshwar too. Continuity: Ranvijay is still mounted on his black stallion. Agnivesh draws with his right hand from the scabbard at his left hip, and the sword falls onto the sand in front of him. The book he set down in shot 16 stays where it lies.
shots.sound_effects: Steel scraping from the scabbard + crackling hum + sword thudding into sand + eruption of laughter

input.scene_heading: Scene 1: EXT. RAJMAHAL - DAY TO NIGHT (TIME-LAPSE) (Shot 1 / 4s)
input.scene_intent_text:
Emotional Target: The weight of the institution; night closing in after the events of Ep 1.
Atmosphere Direction: Monumental, grand, ominous.
Camera Intent: An extreme-wide time-lapse with a gentle aerial drift-in toward the main dome. The sun races across the sky, the shadows sweep, and a bright full moon rises over the domes. The drift stays small so the day first frame and the moonlit last frame line up.
Spatial Staging & Distance: The palace domes sit in the middle third, with the sky and moon in the top third and the terraces and valley mist in the bottom third.
Acting Notes: No characters.
Lighting Plan:
Start on the Rajmahal Exterior plate's golden daylight, with clear sky and long shadows.
Move through a short amber dusk as the windows light up one by one with oil lamps.
End on the Moonlit Night plate: a deep-indigo starry sky, the full moon just above the main dome, a silver moonlight rim on the domes, lamp-lit windows and valley mist.

shots.camera_movement: Slow aerial drift-in toward the main dome as a time-lapse, kept gentle so the day first frame and the moonlit last frame line up; 9:16 vertical composition, all characters fully inside frame
shots.frame_description: The Suryagarh palace on its hillside as the sun races across the sky and golden day melts into a starry night with a full moon rising over the domes. Panel keyframe: the moonlit end frame.
shots.character_action: Time-lapse: the sun races across the sky above the palace; daylight melts into a dark, starry night as a bright full moon rises over its domes. Continuity: the episode opens here (Ep 1 ended on the hard cut on the glowing wrist mark). First frame Rajmahal Exterior (day), last frame Moonlit Night (same framing, first-and-last-frame mode); the aerial drift toward the main dome stays small so the two frames still line up.
shots.sound_effects: Time-lapse whoosh + day ambience dissolving into crickets and night wind

input.title: Khatre ka Sanket
input.scene_heading: Scene 2: INT. ROYAL ARCHIVES - NIGHT (Shots 2–20 / 117s)
input.scene_intent_text:
Emotional Target: Toxic provocation met with icy moral defiance.
Atmosphere Direction: Claustrophobic, hostile, volatile.
Camera Intent:
Opening: A slow crane down from the vault onto the glowing seven-gate hologram, with Devika turning the compass and Agnivesh leaning in (2).
The entrance: The doors burst open on a snap push-in (fast beat 1, 3). Ranvijay struts around Agnivesh on a slow circular track (4).
The insults:
Over-the-shoulder shots and dolly-ins carry the insults (5, 6, 13, 15).
A low-angle tilt up on Ranvijay waving the map away (9).
A slow tilt down finds Agnivesh's fist and the glow through his sleeve (7).
A slow track-out ahead of Ranvijay as he grips the hilt and advances toward the lens, so he grows in frame and the move ends behind Agnivesh's shoulder for the over-the-shoulder (14).
Devika: A crane down from the violet seal to Devika (8), then a high arc around the table as she points to the gates (10).
The lips: A track with Ranvijay up the left side into a profile two-shot of his finger on Devika's lips (11).
The shove: A handheld-energy push (fast beat 2, 12).
The guards: Agnivesh's reply is a static hold (16). The guards are summoned on a high crane-back (17).
Devika parts them: A low-angle push-in as Devika parts the brothers (18). A top-down crane as the hologram collapses into the map (19). A tilt up as she folds it and walks out through the archway (20).
Spatial Staging & Distance:
The table runs from the double doors at the near end to the shelves and stone archway at the far end.
Devika stands at the far end facing the doors. Agnivesh is at the table's right side.
Ranvijay enters from the doors, circles behind Agnivesh to the near end, then walks up the left side to Devika.
The guards halt just inside the doorway, then draw and stride up to stand behind Ranvijay.
Devika sets her compass on the table before pushing the brothers apart. The brothers step back into the top third, one either side of her.
Acting Notes:
Agnivesh:
Absorbed in the map; he does not look up when the doors crash open.
He answers without raising his voice. The only tells are a set jaw, a slow breath and the fist closing behind his back.
On the finger on Devika's lips, a flash in the eyes, then decisive action. The shove is functional, not theatrical.
Afterwards he is completely still again. The rebuke is level and cutting, not shouted.
Devika:
Focused and professional over the map. She notices the flicker with a small, real frown, and her urgency is controlled.
When Ranvijay touches her lips, she goes still with cold eyes: no flinch, no melodrama.
She parts the brothers with a firm, economical push, and her line is quiet and pointed.
Ranvijay:
The villain, allowed more size. A swaggering strut and a smirk; he enjoys his audience, loud and mocking.
The insults carry real venom.
After the shove, the humiliation flushes into rage, with his hand going to the hilt. It stays a petulant prince, not a cartoon.
Royal Guards: Impassive and disciplined. "Aadesh Yuvraj" is clipped and dutiful, and they draw in unison.
Lighting Plan:
Base light: Match the Royal Archives plate: brass oil lamps and wall torches as the warm, flickering key, with deep moody shadows and floating dust in the shafts of light.
The hologram: A motivated soft gold source from table height, uplighting Devika's and Agnivesh's faces and catching the brass instruments.
The violet flicker: The flickering northern seal throws a faint violet pulse onto Devika's face (2, 8).
The doors: The burst sends a draught that makes the torch flames flare and shadows jump (3).
The collapse: When the hologram collapses (19), the gold fill drops away and the faces fall back to lamp and torchlight only.
Faces: Lit by the same flicker and colour temperature as the set, with real contact shadows on the table and floor.

shots.sound_effects: Boot step on stone + table creak as he leans + torch crackle

shots.character_action: Agnivesh's right fist closes behind his back. His left hand grips the right sleeve over his wrist; a faint golden glow pulses through the silk, then fades. Continuity: he has straightened and put his hands behind his back; the glow shows only through the cloth and the cuff stays down.

shots.camera_movement: Slow crane down from the flickering seal in the hologram to Devika; 9:16 vertical composition, all characters fully inside frame

input.scene_heading: Scene 4: INT. ARCHIVE WARD CHAMBER - NIGHT (CONTINUOUS) (Shots 23–46 / 132s)
input.scene_intent_text:
Emotional Target: Desperate alarm giving way to absolute sovereign dominance, ending in catastrophic dread.
Atmosphere Direction: Ritualistic, electric, terrifying.
Camera Intent:
The entry (23): A slow track back as they enter. Ranvijay slides the sword back into his sash.
The ritual (24–29):
A high crane as Devika and Agnivesh kneel at the relic and its rings turn (24).
The reaction (25): A two-shot from the map looking up, Devika's face in the top third and Agnivesh's in the bottom third, lit gold from below by the turning relic rings with the dark dome between them. A slow push-in with a gentle rack focus from Agnivesh to Devika.
A low tilt and crane up as the hologram blooms into the dome (26).
A circular track inside the growing hologram (27).
A push-in on the northern gate as it opens and breaches (28).
A tilt down to the spinning compass (29).
The collapse (30): A crane down as the hologram streams into the relic.
The argument (31–34): A low-angle push-in as Devika rises (31) and a low crane up as Agnivesh rises (33). A dolly-in on Ranvijay by the door (32). An over-the-shoulder arc for "kamzor / darpok" (34).
The draw (35–36): An overhead as the guards close in (35). The draw, with a snap push-in to the blade at the throat (fast beat 3, 36).
The blade at the throat (37–41):
A full-shot profile two-shot, both brothers head to toe, the blade a level line at Agnivesh's throat and the dome above, on a slow push-in (37).
A slow crane down past the blade in the foreground to Devika's raised palm and face (38).
A slow arc around Ranvijay for the tirade (39).
A slow push-in as Agnivesh steps into the blade and the nick appears (40).
A low-angle medium wide on Ranvijay's trembling sword arm, the guards watching from behind in depth, on a slow tilt up (41).
The finger (42–44): Starting close on the finger on the blade and the glowing wrist mark, a slow arc track-out reveals his calm face and the sunstone (42). A track-out as the sword swings down and Ranvijay stumbles (43). A static low angle on "Talwaar pakadne se…" (44).
The ending (45–46): A fast track on the charge, stopping dead as the torches gutter (fast beat 4, 45). A crash zoom down onto the violet symbol, stopping on a top-down close-up with the whole symbol inside frame and a margin of dark parchment around it (fast beat 5, 46), then HARD CUT.
Spatial Staging & Distance:
The relic is at the centre. The door is on the west side (screen-left), with the guards on either side of it.
Devika kneels on the relic's far side, facing the camera. Agnivesh kneels on the near side.
Ranvijay waits by the door, arms folded.
On "Gaddaar hamare beech mein hi hai", Devika glances toward Ranvijay.
The guards close in on either side of Agnivesh before the draw, and stay a pace behind him.
The shots tighten from the full chamber to the macro of blade and skin, then open out as Ranvijay stumbles back.
Acting Notes:
Devika:
Over the map before the bloom (25): focused and quietly hopeful as she searches it. Eyes, breath and a slight lean only.
Quiet awe as the hologram blooms. Then dread: her eyes track the failing gate and her breath catches.
She rises fast and alarmed, but grounded.
The glance at Ranvijay on "Gaddaar…" is a quick sideways look that lands and leaves, not a stare.
Her raised palm is steady, and her voice is firm, not pleading.
Agnivesh:
Over the map (25): his brow tightens with unease. No gesture, just the eyes and a held breath.
Calm and controlled. He rises without hurry and answers deep and level.
He steps into the blade without bravado, eyes on Ranvijay's eyes. The nick registers only as a blink.
The finger rises slowly and with certainty. "Talwaar pakadne se…" is almost quiet.
Ranvijay:
Dismissive with folded arms, then wounded pride at "darpok".
The draw is fast and real. The threat is low and shaking.
Real fear sits under the rage: the trembling wrist, a swallow, eyes flicking to the guards.
"Main kisi se nahi darta!" is strained, close to cracking.
The stumble is genuine shock. The charge is full rage.
The freeze is sudden fear: his eyes widen and his breath stops.
Royal Guards:
Impassive as they close in.
At the finger, a shared glance of disbelief and half a step back.
Lighting Plan:
Base light: Match the Archive Ward Chamber plate: warm amber torches as the key, a cool blue-violet moonlight rim, the relic's soft gold glow from below, mystical haze and deep shadow at the edges.
The ritual:
The reaction over the map (25): both faces lit gold from below by the turning relic rings, with the dome dark above them.
The blooming hologram fills the dome with motivated gold light that wraps the kneeling figures (26–27).
At the breach the northern gate turns violet-black, throwing cold violet onto Devika's face, and that sector of the dome goes dark (28–29).
After the collapse (30) the light returns to torches and the relic.
The finger: The mark's gold glow and the sunstone flicker act as small practical sources, lighting the finger and the blade (42).
The ending:
The map symbol flashes violet. Every torch gutters at once to red embers and smoke (45).
From then on, the violet glow is the only light: hard, cold, from below, catching only Ranvijay's raised blade and eyes.
Then the hard cut (46).
Integration: Skin, metal and fabric take the same flicker, colour and direction as the plate (warm amber on the breastplate and the sword, gold uplight from the relic), with real contact shadows on the stone floor.
Lighting Direction (all scenes)
Match the plate: Every shot is lit to match its location asset's lighting: the same direction, colour temperature, contrast and haze.
Integrated characters: Characters are lit by the set's own sources, never by a separate flat key, so they never look pasted-on. Contact shadows, bounce and flicker must agree with the plate.
Period-correct sources only: Oil lamps, torches, moonlight and daylight. The hologram, the relic, the mark and the violet symbol are treated as motivated light sources (gold or violet) that spill onto faces and surfaces.
Look: Photorealistic live-action, with natural skin texture and real fabric and metal. No CGI look, no plastic skin, no glossy game-engine light.
Contrast: Low-key chiaroscuro throughout the night interiors. Highlights stay on faces and hands in the centre third.

input.title: Khatre ka Sanket
input.scene_heading: Scene 4: INT. ARCHIVE WARD CHAMBER - NIGHT (CONTINUOUS) (Shots 23–46 / 132s)
input.scene_intent_text:
Emotional Target: Desperate alarm giving way to absolute sovereign dominance, ending in catastrophic dread.
Atmosphere Direction: Ritualistic, electric, terrifying.
Camera Intent:
The entry (23): A slow track back as they enter. Ranvijay slides the sword back into his sash.
The ritual (24–29):
A high crane as Devika and Agnivesh kneel at the relic and its rings turn (24).
The reaction (25): A two-shot from the map looking up, Devika's face in the top third and Agnivesh's in the bottom third, lit gold from below by the turning relic rings with the dark dome between them. A slow push-in with a gentle rack focus from Agnivesh to Devika.
A low tilt and crane up as the hologram blooms into the dome (26).
A circular track inside the growing hologram (27).
A push-in on the northern gate as it opens and breaches (28).
A tilt down to the spinning compass (29).
The collapse (30): A crane down as the hologram streams into the relic.
The argument (31–34): A low-angle push-in as Devika rises (31) and a low crane up as Agnivesh rises (33). A dolly-in on Ranvijay by the door (32). An over-the-shoulder arc for "kamzor / darpok" (34).
The draw (35–36): An overhead as the guards close in (35). The draw, with a snap push-in to the blade at the throat (fast beat 3, 36).
The blade at the throat (37–41):
A full-shot profile two-shot, both brothers head to toe, the blade a level line at Agnivesh's throat and the dome above, on a slow push-in (37).
A slow crane down past the blade in the foreground to Devika's raised palm and face (38).
A slow arc around Ranvijay for the tirade (39).
A slow push-in as Agnivesh steps into the blade and the nick appears (40).
A low-angle medium wide on Ranvijay's trembling sword arm, the guards watching from behind in depth, on a slow tilt up (41).
The finger (42–44): Starting close on the finger on the blade and the glowing wrist mark, a slow arc track-out reveals his calm face and the sunstone (42). A track-out as the sword swings down and Ranvijay stumbles (43). A static low angle on "Talwaar pakadne se…" (44).
The ending (45–46): A fast track on the charge, stopping dead as the torches gutter (fast beat 4, 45). A crash zoom down onto the violet symbol, stopping on a top-down close-up with the whole symbol inside frame and a margin of dark parchment around it (fast beat 5, 46), then HARD CUT.
Spatial Staging & Distance:
The relic is at the centre. The door is on the west side (screen-left), with the guards on either side of it.
Devika kneels on the relic's far side, facing the camera. Agnivesh kneels on the near side.
Ranvijay waits by the door, arms folded.
On "Gaddaar hamare beech mein hi hai", Devika glances toward Ranvijay.
The guards close in on either side of Agnivesh before the draw, and stay a pace behind him.
The shots tighten from the full chamber to the macro of blade and skin, then open out as Ranvijay stumbles back.
Acting Notes:
Devika:
Over the map before the bloom (25): focused and quietly hopeful as she searches it. Eyes, breath and a slight lean only.
Quiet awe as the hologram blooms. Then dread: her eyes track the failing gate and her breath catches.
She rises fast and alarmed, but grounded.
The glance at Ranvijay on "Gaddaar…" is a quick sideways look that lands and leaves, not a stare.
Her raised palm is steady, and her voice is firm, not pleading.
Agnivesh:
Over the map (25): his brow tightens with unease. No gesture, just the eyes and a held breath.
Calm and controlled. He rises without hurry and answers deep and level.
He steps into the blade without bravado, eyes on Ranvijay's eyes. The nick registers only as a blink.
The finger rises slowly and with certainty. "Talwaar pakadne se…" is almost quiet.
Ranvijay:
Dismissive with folded arms, then wounded pride at "darpok".
The draw is fast and real. The threat is low and shaking.
Real fear sits under the rage: the trembling wrist, a swallow, eyes flicking to the guards.
"Main kisi se nahi darta!" is strained, close to cracking.
The stumble is genuine shock. The charge is full rage.
The freeze is sudden fear: his eyes widen and his breath stops.
Royal Guards:
Impassive as they close in.
At the finger, a shared glance of disbelief and half a step back.
Lighting Plan:
Base light: Match the Archive Ward Chamber plate: warm amber torches as the key, a cool blue-violet moonlight rim, the relic's soft gold glow from below, mystical haze and deep shadow at the edges.
The ritual:
The reaction over the map (25): both faces lit gold from below by the turning relic rings, with the dome dark above them.
The blooming hologram fills the dome with motivated gold light that wraps the kneeling figures (26–27).
At the breach the northern gate turns violet-black, throwing cold violet onto Devika's face, and that sector of the dome goes dark (28–29).
After the collapse (30) the light returns to torches and the relic.
The finger: The mark's gold glow and the sunstone flicker act as small practical sources, lighting the finger and the blade (42).
The ending:
The map symbol flashes violet. Every torch gutters at once to red embers and smoke (45).
From then on, the violet glow is the only light: hard, cold, from below, catching only Ranvijay's raised blade and eyes.
Then the hard cut (46).
Integration: Skin, metal and fabric take the same flicker, colour and direction as the plate (warm amber on the breastplate and the sword, gold uplight from the relic), with real contact shadows on the stone floor.
Lighting Direction (all scenes)
Match the plate: Every shot is lit to match its location asset's lighting: the same direction, colour temperature, contrast and haze.
Integrated characters: Characters are lit by the set's own sources, never by a separate flat key, so they never look pasted-on. Contact shadows, bounce and flicker must agree with the plate.
Period-correct sources only: Oil lamps, torches, moonlight and daylight. The hologram, the relic, the mark and the violet symbol are treated as motivated light sources (gold or violet) that spill onto faces and surfaces.
Look: Photorealistic live-action, with natural skin texture and real fabric and metal. No CGI look, no plastic skin, no glossy game-engine light.
Contrast: Low-key chiaroscuro throughout the night interiors. Highlights stay on faces and hands in the centre third.

input.scene_intent_text:
Emotional Target: Suspended violence collapsing into a cold, bureaucratic arrest.
Atmosphere Direction: Ritualistic, hushed, unsettled.

input.title: Mita Hua Rajkumar
input.scene_heading: Scene 2: INT. SURYA MANDIR - NIGHT (MOMENTS LATER) (Shots 11–39 / 193s)
input.scene_intent_text:
Emotional Target: Public humiliation met with unbroken dignity, ending in a silent, fateful drop.
Atmosphere Direction: Sacred, formal, oppressive, then trembling.
Camera Intent:
Entry (11–14): A track-in from the great doors behind the guards up the aisle (Throne Axis From the Doors). A crane down the pillar from its crowning mandala to the gilded name. An arc around Agnivesh's eyes on the crowd. A high crane down from the platform toward the doors as Devika and Ranvijay enter (Reverse View Toward the Temple Doors), a true 180° reverse with the sides flipped: Ranvijay arrives near, bottom-right; Devika stops screen-left of the pillar.
The address (15–18): Back on the forward axis, a low crane down from the mandala to the throne platform as Badrinath passes his staff and steps forward. A low push-in on his opening. A single over-the-shoulder shot past Agnivesh, racking focus from him to Devika as their eyes meet, his arms still held by the guards just below frame. A snap push-in on the pointing accusation (fast beat 2).
The argument (19–23): A track-out from Agnivesh as the guards tighten their hold, revealing the pillar; a track with Devika; a high crane down from Someshwar's raised hand to Devika being stopped; a low angle from just behind Agnivesh, craning up the platform steps to Someshwar on the throne for "Maun raho"; a track-in on "Pitashri!".
The decree (24–26): A track-out from the unrolling scroll to Badrinath; a top-down overhead craning down onto Agnivesh alone on the floor between the courtier rows as the decree lands off-screen; a low crane up as Someshwar rises and takes the brush.
The erasure (27–31): A track alongside Someshwar down the steps. One unbroken crane that starts on the ash-black brush in Someshwar's hand, follows it down the pillar as the ash covers the name, and ends on Agnivesh's reflection in the polished stone (first frame Pillar of the Sun Kings, last frame Name Erased (Ash-Paste)). A 4s cutaway of Badrinath watching coldly. A low arc on Ranvijay with the courtiers clapping behind. A low push-in on his gloat.
Exile and defiance (32–37): An over-the-shoulder push-in on Someshwar's decree, Guard 2's gauntlet on Agnivesh's upper right arm at the lower-right edge; a tilt down to the fist and back, the grip on the upper arm leaving the fist free (33). Then one slow arc around Agnivesh carries the disowning: it begins on his defiance (34), is broken once by the wide from behind Someshwar's pointing arm to the open doors and the distant Archive Tower (35, Reverse View Toward the Temple Doors: a true 180° reverse, sides flipped, Someshwar near, bottom-right, his right arm flung to screen-left, hands empty), continues back on the forward axis around Agnivesh while Someshwar's "Tum Suryagarh ka tej nahi..." plays off-screen left (36), and settles close as he lowers his head and the cut reopens with a bead of fresh blood (37).
The drop (38–39): A static, floor-level slow-motion drop (static hold); a fast tilt and crane up the pillar to the open roof (fast beat 3).
Spatial Staging & Distance:
The great doors are at the near end, the Pillar of the Sun Kings free-standing at the centre of the hall, and the raised throne platform with the Sun Throne at the far end beneath the gilded mandala.
Royal Priests stand in a line on either side of the platform; Royal Courtiers crowd along both side walls.
Agnivesh is held a pace in front of the pillar, his gilded name at about knee height beside him. Guard 1 holds his left arm, Guard 2 his right.
Devika stands at the front of the courtiers on the hall's right side as seen from the doors (screen-right; screen-left of the pillar in the 14 reverse); Ranvijay at the foot of the platform, screen-left (near, screen-right in the 14 reverse). At 20 Devika steps out and stops a few paces short of the platform steps, screen-right; she stays there for the rest of the scene (through the end of Track 6 at 26, the erasure, and near the platform steps at 39).
Badrinath hands his staff to the nearest priest before he steps to the platform's edge; a priest takes the scroll and holds the ash-paste bowl.
When Someshwar raises his hand, Guard 2 alone releases Agnivesh's right arm and steps in front of Devika, arm across her path (21); Guard 1 keeps hold of Agnivesh. Guard 2 is back on Agnivesh's right arm by 22.
Someshwar comes down the steps to stand a few paces from Agnivesh beside the pillar for the erasure and the exile. While he is off-screen during 33–34 a priest takes the brush from him; his hands are empty from 35.
Acting Notes:
Agnivesh: Bewildered, then shocked at the accusation, then steady. "Pitashri!" is hurt, controlled, never pleading. Watching the erasure, only the jaw and the fist move. The defiance is low and slow. He lowers his head not in defeat but in grief.
Someshwar: A cold, self-righteous king. "Maun raho" is a blade, not a shout. The erasure is performed deliberately, as a ritual. His fury at "Vansh ka naam" is the one moment his control slips; the disowning that follows is heard off-screen over Agnivesh, so the weight sits on the son's face.
Badrinath: Grave, measured, almost compassionate in tone, which makes it worse. The pointing accusation rises in pitch, and the decree is read merciless and formal. During the erasure (29) he watches with cold, still eyes: satisfaction held completely in check. No smirk in this scene; the smile is saved for the last shot.
Devika: Firm and urgent, stepping out of place in a court where she has no right to speak. Stopped by the guard, she holds her ground and does not push past.
Ranvijay: Smug again. The smile comes first, then the loud gloat; he enjoys the applause.
Courtiers: Mixed and human. A few clap; others look away or at each other.
Priests: Formal and still; one holds the staff, one the bowl and the scroll, and one takes the brush from Someshwar off-screen (33–34).
Guards: Impassive, impersonal, a firm grip.
Lighting Plan:
Base: Match the High Sun Temple plate: hundreds of brass oil lamps as the warm, flickering key, cool blue moonlight through the roof oculus as a backlight, volumetric shafts, drifting incense smoke and golden haze, low-key chiaroscuro.
The platform: The Sun Throne and mandala catch gold highlights from the lamps; the faces on the platform are lit from below by the lamp rows on the steps.
The pillar: Moonlight from the oculus rims the pillar; the gilded names glint in lamplight until the ash makes the erased name a dead matte black.
The reflection: The polished stone band beside the name catches the lamps; Agnivesh's reflected face is lit warm from the lamp rows (28).
The overhead: From above, the lamp pools on the floor isolate Agnivesh in a ring of light between the darker courtier rows (25).
The wrist: A faint warm-gold glow through the silk of the scorched cuff, a small motivated source (33).
The reverse to the doors: Lamp key inside, cool night through the open doors (35).
The drop: Lamplight caught in the falling drop (38). During the rumble the lamps sway and shadows swing (39); no violet light inside the temple yet.
Integration: Skin, metal and fabric take the same flicker and colour as the plate, with real contact shadows on the stone floor.

A single over-the-shoulder shot past Agnivesh, racking focus from him to Devika as their eyes meet, his arms still held by the guards just below frame. A snap push-in on the pointing accusation (fast beat 2).
The argument (19–23): A track-out from Agnivesh as the guards tighten their hold, revealing the pillar; a track with Devika; a high crane down from Someshwar's raised hand to Devika being stopped; a low angle from just behind Agnivesh, craning up the platform steps to Someshwar on the throne for "Maun raho"; a track-in on "Pitashri!".
The decree (24–26): A track-out from the unrolling scroll to Badrinath; a top-down overhead craning down onto Agnivesh alone on the floor between the courtier rows as the decree lands off-screen; a low crane up as Someshwar rises and takes the brush.
The erasure (27–31): A track alongside Someshwar down the steps. One unbroken crane that starts on the ash-black brush in Someshwar's hand, follows it down the pillar as the ash covers the name, and ends on Agnivesh's reflection in the polished stone (first frame Pillar of the Sun Kings, last frame Name Erased (Ash-Paste)). A 4s cutaway of Badrinath watching coldly. A low arc on Ranvijay with the courtiers clapping behind. A low push-in on his gloat.
Exile and defiance (32–37): An over-the-shoulder push-in on Someshwar's decree, Guard 2's gauntlet on Agnivesh's upper right arm at the lower-right edge; a tilt down to the fist and back, the grip on the upper arm leaving the fist free (33). Then one slow arc around Agnivesh carries the disowning: it begins on his defiance (34), is broken once by the wide from behind Someshwar's pointing arm to the open doors and the distant Archive Tower (35, Reverse View Toward the Temple Doors: a true 180° reverse, sides flipped, Someshwar near, bottom-right, his right arm flung to screen-left, hands empty), continues back on the forward axis around Agnivesh while Someshwar's "Tum Suryagarh ka tej nahi..." plays off-screen left (36), and settles close as he lowers his head and the cut reopens with a bead of fresh blood (37).
The drop (38–39): A static, floor-level slow-motion drop (static hold); a fast tilt and crane up the pillar to the open roof (fast beat 3).
Spatial Staging & Distance:
The great doors are at the near end, the Pillar of the Sun Kings free-standing at the centre of the hall, and the raised throne platform with the Sun Throne at the far end beneath the gilded mandala.
Royal Priests stand in a line on either side of the platform; Royal Courtiers crowd along both side walls.
Agnivesh is held a pace in front of the pillar, his gilded name at about knee height beside him. Guard 1 holds his left arm, Guard 2 his right.
Devika stands at the front of the courtiers on the hall's right side as seen from the doors (screen-right; screen-left of the pillar in the 14 reverse); Ranvijay at the foot of the platform, screen-left (near, screen-right in the 14 reverse). At 20 Devika steps out and stops a few paces short of the platform steps, screen-right; she stays there for the rest of the scene (through the end of Track 6 at 26, the erasure, and near the platform steps at 39).
Badrinath hands his staff to the nearest priest before he steps to the platform's edge; a priest takes the scroll and holds the ash-paste bowl.
When Someshwar raises his hand, Guard 2 alone releases Agnivesh's right arm and steps in front of Devika, arm across her path (21); Guard 1 keeps hold of Agnivesh. Guard 2 is back on Agnivesh's right arm by 22.
Someshwar comes down the steps to stand a few paces from Agnivesh beside the pillar for the erasure and the exile. While he is off-screen during 33–34 a priest takes the brush from him; his hands are empty from 35.
Acting Notes:
Agnivesh: Bewildered, then shocked at the accusation, then steady. "Pitashri!" is hurt, controlled, never pleading. Watching the erasure, only the jaw and the fist move. The defiance is low and slow. He lowers his head not in defeat but in grief.
Someshwar: A cold, self-righteous king. "Maun raho" is a blade, not a shout. The erasure is performed deliberately, as a ritual. His fury at "Vansh ka naam" is the one moment his control slips; the disowning that follows is heard off-screen over Agnivesh, so the weight sits on the son's face.
Badrinath: Grave, measured, almost compassionate in tone, which makes it worse. The pointing accusation rises in pitch, and the decree is read merciless and formal. During the erasure (29) he watches with cold, still eyes: satisfaction held completely in check. No smirk in this scene; the smile is saved for the last shot.
Devika: Firm and urgent, stepping out of place in a court where she has no right to speak. Stopped by the guard, she holds her ground and does not push past.
Ranvijay: Smug again. The smile comes first, then the loud gloat; he enjoys the applause.
Courtiers: Mixed and human. A few clap; others look away or at each other.
Priests: Formal and still; one holds the staff, one the bowl and the scroll, and one takes the brush from Someshwar off-screen (33–34).
Guards: Impassive, impersonal, a firm grip.
Lighting Plan:
Base: Match the High Sun Temple plate: hundreds of brass oil lamps as the warm, flickering key, cool blue moonlight through the roof oculus as a backlight, volumetric shafts, drifting incense smoke and golden haze, low-key chiaroscuro.
The platform: The Sun Throne and mandala catch gold highlights from the lamps; the faces on the platform are lit from below by the lamp rows on the steps.
The pillar: Moonlight from the oculus rims the pillar; the gilded names glint in lamplight until the ash makes the erased name a dead matte black.
The reflection: The polished stone band beside the name catches the lamps; Agnivesh's reflected face is lit warm from the lamp rows (28).
The overhead: From above, the lamp pools on the floor isolate Agnivesh in a ring of light between the darker courtier rows (25).
The wrist: A faint warm-gold glow through the silk of the scorched cuff, a small motivated source (33).
The reverse to the doors: Lamp key inside, cool night through the open doors (35).
The drop: Lamplight caught in the falling drop (38). During the rumble the lamps sway and shadows swing (39); no violet light inside the temple yet.
Integration: Skin, metal and fabric take the same flicker and colour as the plate, with real contact shadows on the stone floor.

input.scene_heading: Scene 3: EXT. SURYAGARH CITADEL - NIGHT (CONTINUOUS) (Shots 40–49 / 60s)
input.scene_intent_text:
Emotional Target: Terror at a cosmic omen, twisted into blame, with the truth spoken and ignored.
Atmosphere Direction: Apocalyptic, chaotic, then icy.
Camera Intent:
The crack (40–41): An extreme wide of the city from the carved temple terrace, with a slow push-in as the dome cracks, held a beat longer on the cracked dome (first frame Suryagarh Citadel, last frame Raksha-Kavach Cracked (Violet Thunder)). The whole city sits inside the dome: its shell arches overhead and in front of the shikhara and palace spires, its walls curve down to the ground on both sides, and the mountains, the sea and the moon lie outside it. The crack runs across the top of the shell from the far northern side, branching toward camera, with violet thunder arcing down inside the dome. Then a worm's-eye tilt from the empty temple steps up to violet thunder forking along the crack, the shikhara standing inside the shell (Temple Steps, Low Angle).
The steps (42): A fast track back ahead of the court as it bursts out of the doors, between the fire bowls (fast beat 4), the court stacked in depth down the steps, never in a line.
The blame (43–44): A low push-in on Badrinath pointing, then a reverse over his arm onto Agnivesh held between the guards.
Fear and truth (45–47): An arc around Someshwar, finding Ranvijay stepping back behind him; an insert on the spinning compass (Spinning Needle State); a low push-in on Devika's line.
The ending (48–49): A crane up over the frightened court, stacked in depth, to the shikhara and the crack spreading across the shell overhead; a slow push-in on Badrinath's half-smile under the cracked dome; HARD CUT.
Spatial Staging & Distance:
The court spills from the great doors down the wide temple steps that overlook the citadel. The temple, the terrace, the steps and the whole city are inside the Raksha-Kavach: the shell arches overhead and its walls come down to the ground on both sides, beyond the temple; the mountains and the sea are outside it.
Screen-left group: Someshwar and Badrinath (a pair), Ranvijay behind them. Screen-right group: Agnivesh tight between Guards 1 and 2 (middle-right, higher), and Devika a step behind him.
Courtiers stacked in depth on the steps, nearest camera (42, 48). Nobody stands in a line across the frame.
Acting Notes:
Badrinath: Triumphant and accusing in public, then, in the final close-up, a faint, cold half-smile that nobody else sees. Barely a movement; it should read as the same man who watched the erasure (29).
Someshwar: Anger aimed at his son, with fear underneath.
Ranvijay: Fear wins over swagger; he steps back and grips the hilt.
Devika: Defiant and clear over the thunder, the evidence in her hand.
Agnivesh: Silent, held, looking up at the crack, a thin trace of fresh blood at the nick. No reaction to the blame; he is thinking.
Courtiers: Real fear: hands to mouths, people pulling back.
Lighting Plan:
Base: Match the regenerated Suryagarh Citadel plate (v2): warm amber fire bowls and lamp glow on the terrace and steps, cool blue moonlight and starlight above, and the golden glow of the dome washing down over the rooftops from the shell overhead (we are inside it).
The crack: A cold violet flicker from the fracture and the violet thunder is the only new light, rimming faces and the stone, flickering in time with the thunder.
The empty steps: The fire bowls whipped by the wind, warm against the violet thunder overhead (41).
The doors: Warm oil-lamp light spilling out of the temple doors behind the court (42).
The compass: Violet flicker on the brass (46).
The half-smile: Half his face warm from a fire bowl, half cold violet (49).
Lighting Direction (all scenes)
Match the plate: Every shot is lit to match its location asset: the same direction, colour temperature, contrast and haze.
Integrated characters: Characters are lit by the set's own sources, never by a separate flat key, so they never look pasted-on. Contact shadows, bounce and flicker must agree with the plate.
Period-correct sources only: Oil lamps, torches, fire bowls and moonlight. The relic, the violet map symbol, the wrist glow, the Raksha-Kavach dome and the violet crack are treated as motivated light sources (gold or violet) that spill onto faces and surfaces. No electric light.
Look: Photorealistic live-action, with natural skin texture and real fabric and metal. No CGI look, no plastic skin, no glossy game-engine light.
Contrast: Low-key chiaroscuro throughout. Highlights stay on faces and hands in the centre third.
Time: The whole episode plays at night; every video prompt opens with "at night".

input.scene_heading: Scene 5: EXT. HARBOR BARRACKS GATE - NIGHT (CONTINUOUS) (Shots 41–79 / 133s)
input.scene_intent_text:
Emotional Target: Desperation turning into awe, then dread.
Atmosphere Direction: Brutal, close, wet stone and surf; then the eerie stillness of the retreat.
Camera Intent:
The overrun (41–48): FAST 9–13 (a push toward the gate, a low track with the stalking hound, a snap tilt with the swipe, a snap zoom on the bite, a handheld lateral track with the drag), then a locked-off insert of the dropped sword and a slow crane down on the pinned sentry.
The arrival and the throw (49–53): a low push-in up the shore road; FAST 14–17, the leap, the speed-ramp throw, the snap back.
The stillness (54–59): locked-off at ground level on the reverse as the hound lands dead (Reverse From the Gate Toward the Shore); a slow drift over the smoke from its mouth; locked-off on the staring pack, on Devika, and on the sentry's trembling face.
The cries and the command (60–67): a track-in on the sentry; a track back with Agnivesh and the wounded; a tilt up to the hound on the wall and a drift down the splitting stone; a crane up as he pulls a spear from the rack; a crane down over the hounds' backs as he paces across the gateway.
The climax (68–75): the warning cut off; FAST 18–24 as described above.
The aftermath (76–79): a push-in past Devika and the sentries; a push-in past the impaled hound as the pack retreats; a slow dolly out from Kaalini's eyes to her silhouette.
Spatial Staging & Distance: The base view looks from the beach toward the gate; the reverse looks out from the gate apron to the beach, the sea and the black rock. Agnivesh's back is to the gate from 67 on; the wounded, Devika and the sentries are inside the gateway behind him.
Acting Notes: The Royal Sentry terrified and hurt, his anger at Ranvijay is panic, not politics; Agnivesh loud only for the command (61) and the last warning (76), cold and clear for the cut-off warning (68); Devika frozen at the throw (58), then practical with the wounded; Kaalini a silhouette only, no face detail, unhurried.
Lighting Plan: Cool moonlight on the water and sand, warm wall torches on the stone, sea mist, the cracked dome with violet thunder flicker overhead; violet hound eyes and purple hound smoke; at 75 the golden fire floods the shore, and a warm gold glow stays on his wrist through 77.
Lighting Direction (all scenes)
Match the plate: Every shot is lit to match its location asset: the same direction, colour temperature, contrast and haze.
Period-correct sources only: Torches, fire bowls and moonlight. The map symbols, the dome, the crack, the hound eyes and the mark are motivated gold or violet light sources. No electric light.
Contrast: Low-key chiaroscuro throughout. Highlights stay on faces and hands in the centre third.
Time: The whole episode plays at night; every track prompt opens with "at night".
Smoke Rules (Nin's style, applied to every prompt)
The Shadow Hounds trail violet-purple smoke as they move, leak it from any wound, and their smoke stays purple when they die. Never black or grey on the hounds.
v5: the storyboard itself is now purple everywhere (55, 60, 73). Hound #1 dissolves into purple smoke in its own shot (57, 3s); the impaled hound stays on the planted spear to the end of Ep 4, leaking purple (73, 77, 78), and dissolves in Ep 5 shots 4–5. This deviates from the script's "black smoke" by Nin's approval.
The sea mist around Kaalini is tinged purple (79).
