input.scene_intent_text:
Emotional Target: Desperation turning into awe, then dread.
Atmosphere Direction: Brutal, close, wet stone and surf; then the eerie stillness of the retreat.
Camera Intent:
The overrun (41–48): FAST 9–13 (a push toward the gate, a low track with the stalking hound, a snap tilt with the swipe, a snap zoom on the bite, a handheld lateral track with the drag), then a locked-off insert of the dropped sword and a slow crane down on the pinned sentry.
The arrival and the throw (49–53): a low push-in up the shore road; FAST 14–17, the leap, the speed-ramp throw, the snap back.
The stillness (54–59): locked-off at ground level on the reverse as the hound lands dead (Reverse From the Gate Toward the Shore); a slow drift over the smoke from its mouth; locked-off on the staring pack, on Devika, and on the sentry's trembling face.
The cries and the command (60–67): a track-in on the sentry; a track back with Agnivesh and the wounded; a tilt up to the hound on the wall and a drift down the splitting stone; a crane up as he pulls a spear from the rack; a crane down over the hounds' backs as he paces across the gateway.
The climax (68–75): the warning cut off; FAST 18–24 as described above.
The aftermath (76–79): a push-in past Devika and the sentries; a push-in past the impaled hound as the pack retreats; a slow dolly out from Kaalini's eyes to her silhouette.
Spatial Staging & Distance: The base view looks from the beach toward the gate; the reverse looks out from the gate apron to the beach, the sea and the black rock. Agnivesh's back is to the gate from 67 on; the wounded, Devika and the sentries are inside the gateway behind him.
Acting Notes: The Royal Sentry terrified and hurt, his anger at Ranvijay is panic, not politics; Agnivesh loud only for the command (61) and the last warning (76), cold and clear for the cut-off warning (68); Devika frozen at the throw (58), then practical with the wounded; Kaalini a silhouette only, no face detail, unhurried.
Lighting Plan: Cool moonlight on the water and sand, warm wall torches on the stone, sea mist, the cracked dome with violet thunder flicker overhead; violet hound eyes and purple hound smoke; at 75 the golden fire floods the shore, and a warm gold glow stays on his wrist through 77.
Lighting Direction (all scenes)
Match the plate: Every shot is lit to match its location asset: the same direction, colour temperature, contrast and haze.
Period-correct sources only: Torches, fire bowls and moonlight. The map symbols, the dome, the crack, the hound eyes and the mark are motivated gold or violet light sources. No electric light.
Contrast: Low-key chiaroscuro throughout. Highlights stay on faces and hands in the centre third.
Time: The whole episode plays at night; every track prompt opens with "at night".
Smoke Rules (Nin's style, applied to every prompt)
The Shadow Hounds trail violet-purple smoke as they move, leak it from any wound, and their smoke stays purple when they die. Never black or grey on the hounds.

The sea mist around Kaalini is tinged purple (79).
Demon smoke is purple (or purple-and-black). Non-magical props give black smoke only (none in this episode).

input.scene_heading: Scene 5: EXT. HARBOR BARRACKS GATE - NIGHT (CONTINUOUS) (Shots 41–79 / 133s)
input.scene_intent_text:
Emotional Target: Desperation turning into awe, then dread.
Atmosphere Direction: Brutal, close, wet stone and surf; then the eerie stillness of the retreat.
Camera Intent:
The overrun (41–48): FAST 9–13 (a push toward the gate, a low track with the stalking hound, a snap tilt with the swipe, a snap zoom on the bite, a handheld lateral track with the drag), then a locked-off insert of the dropped sword and a slow crane down on the pinned sentry.
The arrival and the throw (49–53): a low push-in up the shore road; FAST 14–17, the leap, the speed-ramp throw, the snap back.
The stillness (54–59): locked-off at ground level on the reverse as the hound lands dead (Reverse From the Gate Toward the Shore); a slow drift over the smoke from its mouth; locked-off on the staring pack, on Devika, and on the sentry's trembling face.
The cries and the command (60–67): a track-in on the sentry; a track back with Agnivesh and the wounded; a tilt up to the hound on the wall and a drift down the splitting stone; a crane up as he pulls a spear from the rack; a crane down over the hounds' backs as he paces across the gateway.
The climax (68–75): the warning cut off; FAST 18–24 as described above.
The aftermath (76–79): a push-in past Devika and the sentries; a push-in past the impaled hound as the pack retreats; a slow dolly out from Kaalini's eyes to her silhouette.
Spatial Staging & Distance: The base view looks from the beach toward the gate; the reverse looks out from the gate apron to the beach, the sea and the black rock. Agnivesh's back is to the gate from 67 on; the wounded, Devika and the sentries are inside the gateway behind him.
Acting Notes: The Royal Sentry terrified and hurt, his anger at Ranvijay is panic, not politics; Agnivesh loud only for the command (61) and the last warning (76), cold and clear for the cut-off warning (68); Devika frozen at the throw (58), then practical with the wounded; Kaalini a silhouette only, no face detail, unhurried.
Lighting Plan: Cool moonlight on the water and sand, warm wall torches on the stone, sea mist, the cracked dome with violet thunder flicker overhead; violet hound eyes and purple hound smoke; at 75 the golden fire floods the shore, and a warm gold glow stays on his wrist through 77.
Lighting Direction (all scenes)
Match the plate: Every shot is lit to match its location asset: the same direction, colour temperature, contrast and haze.
Period-correct sources only: Torches, fire bowls and moonlight. The map symbols, the dome, the crack, the hound eyes and the mark are motivated gold or violet light sources. No electric light.
Contrast: Low-key chiaroscuro throughout. Highlights stay on faces and hands in the centre third.
Time: The whole episode plays at night; every track prompt opens with "at night".
Smoke Rules (Nin's style, applied to every prompt)
The Shadow Hounds trail violet-purple smoke as they move, leak it from any wound, and their smoke stays purple when they die. Never black or grey on the hounds.
v5: the storyboard itself is now purple everywhere (55, 60, 73). Hound #1 dissolves into purple smoke in its own shot (57, 3s); the impaled hound stays on the planted spear to the end of Ep 4, leaking purple (73, 77, 78), and dissolves in Ep 5 shots 4–5. This deviates from the script's "black smoke" by Nin's approval.
The sea mist around Kaalini is tinged purple (79).
Demon smoke is purple (or purple-and-black). Non-magical props give black smoke only (none in this episode).

input.title: The Awakening of the Solar Heir
input.scene_heading: Scene 1: INT. RAJMAHAL: THRONE ROOM – NIGHT
input.scene_intent_text:
Emotional Target: The righteous physical vindication of an exiled prince commanding the throne room that banished him, transitioning from desperate protection to unyielding authority.
Atmosphere Direction: Oppressive, volatile, suffocating, transitioning into awe-struck, vindicated, and sovereign.
Shot Intent: Low-angle mid long and mid shots on Agnivesh for moral dominance; high-angle mid shots and over-the-shoulder shots on Ranvijay and Someshwar for shattered pride; wide grandeur shots for scale (throne dais, pillar collapse, pushback, silence beat). Only TWO close-ups in the episode: the wrist-mark burst and Devika's Dishayantra alignment. No macro shots, no extreme close-ups, no extra close-up reaction shots.
Spatial Narrative: Agnivesh advances from an isolated kneeling captive on the lower marble steps to commanding the central axis of the throne hall, forcing the demonic horde toward the hall perimeter.
Distance Design: High-angle wide grandeur establishing → low-angle full and mid long shots for the fist catch → mid shots and over-the-shoulder shots for the dialogue deadlock → close-up of the wrist-mark burst → wide shots for the shadow warriors and pillar collapse → 360° orbit on Agnivesh's darbaar line → wide shots for the slab freeze and double-palm blast → low-angle wide grandeur hero silence → crash zoom to Timiraksha's stunned, retreating face before the final cut.

shots.frame_description: The throne room is plunged in shadow. The golden sun carving above the throne is dark and dull, and an eerie violet light hangs around the edges of the hall.
shots.character_action: (opening) The throne room is plunged in shadow → golden sun carving above the throne is dark and dull → eerie violet light hangs around the edges of the hall as Someshwar hangs motionless on the dais and Timiraksha looms below
shots.sound_effects: low subterranean hum and distant wind whistling through jali screens

shots.sound_effects: deep reverberating demon snarl and straining sinew groan

shots.frame_description: Ranvijay, pinned beneath the deadlock on the floor, gasps in terror as he stares up at his brother taking the demonic weight

shots.dialogue: Prince Ranvijay: Agnivesh, peeche hat! Yeh tujhe kuchal dega!
shots.sound_effects: strained ragged wheeze and scrape of armor against marble

shots.frame_description: Agnivesh locks his unwavering eyes onto Timiraksha, right arm trembling under immense pressure but holding firm
shots.character_action: (continues from previous: Agnivesh's immovable reply) Agnivesh sets his jaw firm → pupils contract with steel determination → neck tendons tighten without giving an inch

shots.frame_description: Timiraksha leans his full monstrous mass downward, causing the sun floor mosaic to spiderweb and fracture beneath Agnivesh's boots
shots.character_action: (continues from previous: escalating physical force) Timiraksha drops his shoulder and leans full weight down → Agnivesh's knee dips two inches → hairline fractures split outward across the carved marble mosaic
shots.sound_effects: groaning marble fracture and stone grinding crunch

shots.frame_description: Timiraksha bears down with a sneer, his half-open third eye burning with dark violet malice
shots.character_action: (continues from previous: psychological interrogation) Timiraksha leans forward until his face is inches from Agnivesh's brow → cruel smile widens → clawed fingers grind harder into the hold
shots.dialogue: Timiraksha: Jinhone kabhi tujhe apna nahi maana... Tu mujhe unke liye rok raha hai?

input.title: The Royal Darbar Awakening
input.scene_heading: Scene 1: Rajmahal Throne Room (Shots 1–7)
input.scene_intent_text:
Emotional Target: The cruel triumph of court bullies collapsing into paralyzed dread as the outcast's motionless gaze forces the dynasty's sacred crown into airborne submission.
Atmosphere Direction: Oppressive, suffocating, volatile, transitioning abruptly into awe-inspiring, transcendent, and regal.
Shot Intent:
Shot 1 (Establishing Clash): Plunge from a high crane down to floor level as the heavy talwar slides toward the lens, instantly establishing Ranvijay's predatory entitlement and placing the audience at floor level.
Shot 2 (Verbal Assault): Low-angle medium close-up on Ranvijay's sneering mouth, cutting to eye-level medium close-up on Agnivesh's unblinking, relaxed expression to contrast rabid arrogance with unshakeable discipline.
Shot 3 (Court Mockery): Handheld lateral pan across smirking courtiers before pushing into Agnivesh's lowered eyes, emphasizing solitary isolation against an entire hostile institution.
Shot 4 (Patriarchal Condemnation): Over-the-shoulder perspective from behind Agnivesh facing the towering throne dais as Someshwar points downward, framing the crushing weight of royal law bearing down on him.
Shot 5 (Dermal Ignition & Tremor): Extreme macro close-up on the inner wrist as skin lines illuminate with golden fire, followed by a wide snap of swaying chandeliers and falling masonry to prove his bloodline commands the building itself.
Shot 6 (Crown Levitation): Slow-motion vertical tilt following the spinning gold crown lifting away from the empty throne, while courtiers physically stumble back into pillars.
Shot 7 (Sovereign Proclamation): Heroic low-angle close-up pushing into Agnivesh's raised eyes with the crown hovering above his head, cementing his reclamation of divine lineage on the cliffhanger line.
Spatial Narrative: Complete inversion of vertical power. The scene begins with Ranvijay and Someshwar dominating the upper two-thirds of the frame, looking down upon an isolated subject. It ends with the floating crown establishing a new apex above Agnivesh, forcing the throne and court to gaze upward.
Distance Design: Wide establishing slide (3m) → claustrophobic medium close-up confrontation (0.5m) → macro insert on wrist (zero distance) → wide structural shudder (10m) → heroic vertical close-up.

shots.camera_movement: high-angle crane plunge down to floor level with fast push-in tracking the sliding blade
shots.frame_description: Vast pillared throne room packed with courtiers flanking the central aisle; midground Ranvijay strides aggressively forward, flinging his curved talwar across the polished marble floor directly toward Agnivesh standing motionless
shots.character_action: (opening) Ranvijay storms forward four heavy paces along the central aisle → unclasps his curved talwar and whips his right arm downward → blade clatters and skids five paces across the floor, stopping inches before Agnivesh's boots; Agnivesh remains upright with arms hanging relaxed at his sides
shots.sound_effects: metallic hilt slapback echo off marble columns

shots.camera_movement: low-angle push-in on Ranvijay's sneering mouth, then re-framing to hold Agnivesh's stoic jaw
shots.frame_description: Foreground Ranvijay looms over Agnivesh with an arrogant sneer, his right hand pointing contemptuously down at the discarded sword on the floor while Agnivesh holds unwavering eye contact
shots.character_action: (continues from previous: sword skids to rest ~ Ranvijay closes distance) Ranvijay steps into Agnivesh's personal space → curls his upper lip into a mocking sneer → thrusts his right index finger down toward the blade and then toward his own boots; Agnivesh absorbs the insult without blinking, facial muscles locked in stoic composure
shots.dialogue: Ranvijay: Najaayaz aulaad! Pehle meri talwar uthao... phir mere charan chhuo!
shots.sound_effects: scraping leather boots + leather combat boot heel grinding on polished marble

shots.camera_movement: handheld lateral pan right across mocking noble faces, settling into a push-in on Agnivesh's centered figure
shots.frame_description: Colonnade aisle filled with richly robed courtiers pointing, whispering, and bursting into derisive laughter, while Agnivesh remains standing dead-center in solitary stillness with lowered gaze
shots.character_action: (continues from previous: Ranvijay holds sneer ~ courtiers erupt in laughter) Three senior courtiers point fingers and lean into each other laughing → noble behind smirks behind his silk patka; camera pans past them to Agnivesh, whose lowered eyes and still shoulders absorb the collective scorn without flinching
shots.sound_effects: layered mocking laughter and sneering whispers of courtiers + rustling silk angarkhas + low ambient hall hum

shots.camera_movement: low-angle push-in toward the throne dais, framing Someshwar above Agnivesh's silhouetted shoulder
shots.frame_description: Maharaja Someshwar seated atop the seven-step marble dais beneath the carved canopy, crowned with the Golden Mukut, leans forward and points a condemning finger down at Agnivesh seen from behind
shots.character_action: (continues from previous: mockery lingers ~ cut to throne dais) Someshwar grips the carved throne armrest with his left hand → leans his torso forward over the dais steps → extends his right arm fully, pointing his index finger in wrathful condemnation down toward Agnivesh
shots.dialogue: Someshwar: Tujh jaise apshaguni ko rajkumar kehna bhi paap hai!
shots.sound_effects: Someshwar fist slam on wooden throne armrest with vaulted reverberation

shots.camera_movement: static macro hold with micro-shake simulating structural vibration
shots.frame_description: Extreme macro framing on Agnivesh's inner right wrist as the dormant sword-shaped epidermal mark ignites into searing solar fissures, while the marble floor violently trembles underfoot
shots.character_action: (continues from previous: Someshwar's pointing hand locks ~ abrupt silence as wrist ignites) Agnivesh's right wrist tendons tighten → dormant sword-shaped mark beneath the dermal layer ignites into blazing solar runes → fingers slowly unfurl as seismic tremor shakes the stone floor
shots.sound_effects: absolute silence followed by deep tectonic stone vibration + clinking brass chandelier chains and falling masonry dust

shots.camera_movement: slow-motion vertical tilt-up tracking the floating crown as it rises above the throne canopy
shots.frame_description: The tall jeweled Golden Mukut detaches from the throne cushion and ascends vertically into mid-air, rotating slowly along its central axis as courtiers stumble backward in terror
shots.character_action: (continues from previous: tremors shake hall ~ mukut detaches from cushion) The solid gold mukut lifts unassisted from the throne seat → rises vertically past the sun-mandala backrest → begins a slow clockwise spin in suspended levitation; Someshwar recoils against his backrest in shock as flanking courtiers stumble backward against marble pillars
shots.sound_effects: shimmering crystalline metallic resonance of spinning crown + collective gasped breaths + shuffling and stumbling leather boots on marble

shots.camera_movement: low-angle slow push-in directly into Agnivesh's focused eyes, keeping the spinning mukut suspended in background
shots.frame_description: Heroic low-angle perspective on Agnivesh raising his head with supreme calm, eyes blazing with sovereign intensity, as the levitating Golden Mukut hovers suspended directly above him in the hall
shots.character_action: (continues from previous: crown reaches apex suspension ~ Agnivesh lifts gaze) Agnivesh lifts his chin deliberately → eyes raise from the floor and lock straight ahead with unyielding regal authority → chest expands with a slow breath as he proclaims his true lineage, the rotating mukut holding locked suspension above him
shots.dialogue: Agnivesh: Jis khoon ko tum kalank kehte ho... usi mein Surya ka tej hai!
shots.sound_effects: sustained high-frequency metallic hum of levitating mukut + deep resonant vocal delivery echoing across vaulted hall

input.scene_heading: Scene 1: Royal Archives Confrontation (Beats 1A–1D)
input.scene_intent_text:
Emotional Target: Claustrophobic violation transforming into resolute defiance, followed by heart-stopping lethal dread.
Atmosphere Direction: Oppressive, volatile, confrontational.
Shot Intent:
Sc1A (0–5s): Tight medium close-up tracking Prince Ranvijay's reaching hand, snapping focus to Devika's fingers clamping his wrist to prove her physical refusal before her dialogue ends.
Sc1B (5–10s): Medium two-shot punch-in as Agnivesh squares his chest against Prince Ranvijay, capturing unwavering physical parity between brothers.
Sc1C (10–15s): Insert close-up of interlaced fingers, followed by a snap reframe to Prince Ranvijay's flared nostrils and clenching jaw to register the sting of humiliation.
Sc1D (15–20s): Macro close-up on the steel edge depressing Agnivesh's skin without cutting, locking the viewer into immediate physical jeopardy.
Spatial Narrative: Prince Ranvijay initially commands the visual space; Agnivesh seizes the midground buffer; Devika chooses her proximity by stepping up against Agnivesh's shoulder, visually banishing Prince Ranvijay outside their shared plane.
Distance Design: Invasive medium close-up (0.3m invasion) → Rigid barrier (zero distance chest-to-chest) → Lethal contact (zero distance blade-to-skin).

shots.frame_description: Foreground carved teak manuscript cabinet framing the aisle, midground Prince Ranvijay stepping within arm's reach of Devika, background tall sandstone shelves of leather-bound folios
shots.character_action: (opening)Prince Ranvijay advances half a pace forward → lifts his right hand reaching toward Devika's jawline;Devika stands rigid against the archive rack → holds her chin level with unbroken eye contact
shots.dialogue: Ranvijay: Devika! Ek din tumhe meri rani banna hi hoga!
shots.sound_effects: rustle of palm-leaf manuscripts and parchment + heavy silk fabric friction as Ranvijay closes distance

shots.frame_description: Foreground Devika's gauntleted hand clamping Prince Ranvijay's bare wrist mid-air, midground Devika's resolute gaze holding firm, background rows of rolled palm manuscripts
shots.character_action: (continues from previous: right hand reaching toward jawline ~ rigid resistance)Prince Ranvijay's reaching fingers freeze mid-air → wrist tendon tenses under force;Devika's leather-gloved fingers snap shut around his wrist → thrusts his forearm downward away from her face
shots.sound_effects: low acoustic stone hall resonance + sharp leather-and-flesh slap as Devika grips Ranvijay's wrist

shots.frame_description: Foreground carved teak desk corner, midground Agnivesh striding between Prince Ranvijay and Devika to plant a grounded stance, background heavy carved wooden double doors
shots.character_action: (continues from previous: wrist thrust downward ~ confrontation deadlock)Prince Ranvijay recoils half a pace leftward → lowers his captured arm;Agnivesh steps directly across the lens axis → plants both boots between them, squaring his chest against Ranvijay;Devika lowers her arm behind Agnivesh's right shoulder → shifts weight backward
shots.dialogue: Agnivesh: Prem adhikaar nahi, Devika ki ichchha hai!
shots.sound_effects: rustle of palm-leaf manuscripts and parchment + heavy boot-thud against polished stone floor

shots.frame_description: Foreground Prince Ranvijay's tensed shoulder armor, midground Agnivesh's calm resolute countenance confronting him eye-to-eye, background arched sandstone entryway
shots.character_action: (continues from previous: planted boots ~ chest squared)Prince Ranvijay's jaw clenches tight → nostrils flare;Agnivesh holds an unblinking gaze → maintains upright posture without flinching
shots.sound_effects: low acoustic stone hall resonance + tense breathing across the narrow gap

shots.frame_description: Foreground Devika's bare hand reaching forward to clasp Agnivesh's left fingers at his hip, midground silk fabric of Agnivesh's sleeve, background Prince Ranvijay standing opposite
shots.character_action: (continues from previous: unblinking gaze ~ rigid posture)Prince Ranvijay's gaze drops abruptly toward their waists;Agnivesh's fingers uncurl slightly → receives her hand;Devika steps half a pace forward → laces her fingers firmly through Agnivesh's palm
shots.sound_effects: rustle of palm-leaf manuscripts and parchment + soft rustle of silk sleeves and quiet contact of fingers

shots.frame_description: Foreground Prince Ranvijay's right hand ripping his curved talwar from its scabbard, midground his face contorted in rage, background carved teak archive pillars
shots.character_action: (continues from previous: gaze dropped ~ fingers laced)Prince Ranvijay's right hand grasps his talwar hilt → draws seventy centimetres of curved steel clear of the scabbard → levels the point forward;Ranvijay's Sword slides out of scabbard → tip points upward
shots.emotion: wounded pride and explosive fratricidal fury
shots.dialogue: Ranvijay: Mere saamne mere hi bhai ka haath thaamogi?!
shots.sound_effects: low acoustic stone hall resonance + sharp metallic scrape of curved talwar steel sliding from wooden scabbard

shots.frame_description: Foreground Prince Ranvijay thrusting the honed steel blade flush against Agnivesh's neck, midground Agnivesh standing motionless, background Devika watching with parted lips
shots.character_action: (continues from previous: talwar drawn ~ point leveled)Prince Ranvijay lunges forward one step → presses the upper third of his talwar blade flush against Agnivesh's jugular;Agnivesh keeps his chin raised → chest motionless;Devika's breath hitches → grip on Agnivesh's hand tightens;Ranvijay's Sword rests horizontally against the royal-blue silk angrakha collar
shots.emotion: escalating mortal threat and fratricidal hostility
shots.dialogue: Ranvijay: - mere beech me aaya to….
shots.sound_effects: low acoustic stone hall resonance + ringing blade resonance cutting through the air

shots.frame_description: Foreground curved Damascus steel blade edge depressing Agnivesh's neck skin, midground faint bead of crimson surfacing along the metal edge, background blurred blue silk collar
shots.character_action: (continues from previous: blade pressed against jugular ~ grip tightened)Agnivesh's throat swallows once → pulse point throbs against the static steel;Ranvijay's Sword blade holds dead still → micro-bevel edge indents the skin
shots.emotion: heart-stopping mortal peril and lethal suspense
shots.sound_effects: taut flesh compression against steel edge + Agnivesh's shallow throat breathing in dead silence
